faq.q: What do you need from me to start?
faq.a: Your current resume (PDF or Doc) and one or two target roles or job descriptions. The more specific the target, the sharper the rewrite.

faq.q: How is this different from a template or an AI resume tool?
faq.a: Templates fix formatting; they can't tell whether your impact is framed the way a hiring manager reads it. This is a human review from someone who has hired and mentored PMs — focused on positioning and evidence, not just layout.

faq.q: Will it actually pass ATS systems?
faq.a: Yes. I check parsing, section structure, and keyword coverage against your target role so the resume reads cleanly for both the software and the recruiter behind it.

faq.q: Do you rewrite the bullets for me, or just comment?
faq.a: I rewrite. You get concrete, ready-to-use language for your key bullets — not just 'make this stronger.'

faq.q: What if I need more than one round?
faq.a: One follow-up pass on your revised draft is included. If you want ongoing help, we can move to a 1:1 guidance session.
